use: candidate US parser source; sample must be prepared and audited before training
constraints: ODbL 1.0 section 4.4: a derivative database may be distributed only under ODbL
ODbL 1.0 section 4.3: a produced work must carry the notice that it contains data from the database under ODbL
openstreetmap.org/copyright (verified 2026-09-22): 'If you alter or build upon our data, you may distribute the result only under the same license'
format: gzipped TSV with language, country, and tagged address columns. The address column contains token/label pairs such as '1200/house_number Market/road Street/road |/FSEP Philadelphia/city'; '|/FSEP' marks a line break and ',/SEP' a separator.

filters.rules: US ZIP or ZIP+4; reject search queries, invalid spans, and place-only rows above 15% of the quota

notes: Training set date 20170304 from the repository file current_parser_training_set (verified 2026-09-22). The README lists the files under https://archive.org/download/libpostal-parser-training-data-YYYYMMDD/; the older libpostal.s3.amazonaws.com location returns 403. README label: '(ODBL): OSM addresses'. Size on archive.org: 8033490172 bytes.
